sections.heading: ACTIV ONE MAX >
sections.text: Highlights of the Plan

sections.heading: Premium for Activ One MAX starting at
UNIQUE FEATURES OF THE ACTIV ONE MAX PLAN
sections.text:
Up to 100% HealthReturns™
Apart from the adrenaline rush, a fit body and a fitter mind you get by staying active, Activ One also rewards you for adopting a healthier lifestyle! You can earn up to 100% of your premium back as HealthReturnsTM by just walking 10,000 steps or burning 300 calories daily.

sections.heading: Claim Protect (Non-Medical Expense Waiver)
sections.text: Put aside your worries around Non-Medical Expenses accrued during your hospital stay. This feature ensures complete coverage of all Non-Medical Expenses listed in All 4 list of Annexure 1, so that you can focus on health and well-being, not the burden of unexpected expenses.

sections.heading: Super Reload
sections.text: When uncertain times come knocking and you need more than your Sum Insured, this plan has got you covered. With Super Reload, you get Unlimited times refill up to Base Sum Insured from 2nd claim and onwards for all subsequent claims in a policy year.

sections.heading: Super Reload of Sum Insured
sections.text: Your policy will be your friend in times of need with the Super Reload feature. If your Base Sum Insured, inclusive of the accumulated Super Credit, is exhausted/insufficient for covering a claim, we will provide refill of Sum Insured available from 2nd claim and onwards up to 100% of Base Sum Insured unlimited number of times for all subsequent claims in a Policy year.

sections.heading: Claim Protect
sections.text:
Listed Non-Payable Items (All 4 lists of Annexure I) usually make up 10-20% of the total hospital bill amount during hospitalization. With Claim Protect, these expenses are included in the coverage, ensuring that you don’t have to worry about unexpected out of pocket expenses.
Know list of expenses here

sections.heading: Modern Procedures/Treatments
sections.text:
If in the future, you need to undergo a treatment which requires the use of advanced technologies or robotic surgeries, you need not worry about the medical expenses.
The Activ One MAX Health Insurance Plan provides coverage for listed modern treatment methods like Robotic surgeries, Oral chemotherapy, Stem cell therapy and more as a part of In-patient hospitalization or Daycare treatments.

sections.heading: In-Patient Hospitalization Treatment
sections.text: In case of a planned treatment or an unforeseen emergency which leads to hospitalization for more than 24 hours, this plan will cover expenses like room rent, doctor’s fees, operation theater expenses, medicines, drugs and other consumables as actuals up to Base Sum Insured.

sections.heading: Pre and Post Hospitalization Medical Expenses
sections.text: Expenses for consultations, medicines or diagnostic tests before or after hospitalization will be covered for up to 90 days before hospitalization and up to 180 days after discharge from the hospital, once the hospitalization claim is accepted by us.

sections.heading: Day Care Treatment
sections.text: Due to advancements in medical science, certain medical procedures like dialysis, may not require a 24-hour hospitalization. All such procedures will also be covered under this plan.

sections.heading: Road Ambulance Cover
sections.text: We will ensure there is no roadblock to providing you speedy and quality treatment by covering ambulance costs up to the Base Sum Insured.

sections.heading: Organ Donor Expenses
sections.text: All medical expenses for organ transplantation ranging from harvesting organs to transplantation surgeries will be covered as per the Base Sum Insured for the donor.

sections.heading: AYUSH Treatment
sections.text: Your Activ One plan will cover medical expenses incurred towards In-patient Hospitalization under AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy). We will cover reasonable and customary charges up to Base Sum Insured.

sections.heading: Annual Health Check-up Program
sections.text:
Do you skip your mandatory Annual Health Check-ups? We suggest you keep a tab on your health with a preventive listed health check-up, once per policy year for Insured person(s)
aged 18 years and above

sections.heading: Chronic Care (Day 1 In-Patient Hospitalization) - Optional
sections.text:
Leave behind worries of mounting healthcare expenses and hospitalization due to chronic conditions. This benefit provides Day 1 In-Patient Hospitalization (No waiting period) for listed chronic conditions such as:
Asthma
Hypertension
Hyperlipidemia
Diabetes mellitus

sections.heading: Personal Accident Cover - Optional
sections.text: Unforeseen events, which come in the shape of accidents and injuries, may often cause setbacks. With the personal accident cover, you can secure yourself and your family from the financial implications of severe accidents. The payout under this cover will be as per the Personal Accident Sum Insured. Accidental Death, Permanent Total Disablement and Permanent Partial Disablement are covered under Personal Accident Cover.

sections.heading: Room Rent Type Cover - Optional
sections.text: You have the option to select either a Single Private Room or Shared Accommodation, with the added benefit of being eligible for discounts.

sections.heading: Per Claim Deductible Cover - Optional
sections.text: Opt for a Per Claim Deductible cover in your health insurance to enjoy discounted premiums. Pay a predetermined amount per claim before your coverage activates, managing costs effectively.

sections.heading: Reduction in Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period - Optional
sections.text: The default pre-existing disease waiting period with Activ One MAX is 3 years. With this optional cover, you could have it reduced to 2 or 1 year (s).

sections.heading: Reduction in Specific Disease Waiting Period - Optional
sections.text: The default specific disease waiting period with Activ One MAX is 2 years. With this optional cover, you could have it reduced to 1 year.

sections.heading: Cancer Booster - Optional
sections.text:
Under this cover, you'll get additional coverage for medical expenses linked to 'Cancer of Specified Severity' claims during hospitalization, including Pre and Post-hospitalization Expenses, along with coverage for Day Care Treatment expenses up to the sum insured.
Annual Screening Package for Cancer Diagnosed Patients - Optional
When you choose this option, we will reimburse Medical Expenses of INR 10,000 per member per Policy for an Annual Screening Package, applicable to Insured Person(s) diagnosed with Cancer, provided certain conditions are met, including confirmation by a pathologist.
